entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4002 of 2023

Applicant :- Pankaj Nishad And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Bhoopal Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

Heard Mr. Bhoopal Singh, learned counsel for the applicants, Mr. Hari Shankar Maurya, learned A.G.A. for the State and Mr. Pawan Kumar, Advocate who has put in appearance on behalf of the informant and has filed his vakalatnama, which is taken on record.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.350 of 2022, under Sections 376-D, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Motipur, District Bahraich.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 07.07.2022 against three named accused persons, including the applicant alleging that all the three accused persons misbehaved with the informant's daughter aged about 15 years and they tried to drag her towards a sugarcane field with ill intention.
In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicants are innocent and they have been falsely implicated in the present case, they have no criminal history.

The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the other co-accused person Sarvajeet Singh has already been enlarged on bail by this court vide order dated 05.12.2022, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.11833 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.11833 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Pankaj Nishad And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Pankaj Nishad And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the other co-accused person has already been enlarged on bail; that the case as set up against the applicants is similar to that of the case set up against the co-accused person; that the applicants have no previous criminal history and they are languishing in jail since 15.07.2022 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am satisfied that the applicants are entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case crime.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
Let the applicants-Pankaj Nishad and Shailesh Nishad be released on bail in Case Crime No.350 of 2022, under Sections 376-D, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Motipur, District Bahraich on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned,
subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicants shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicants shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicants shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
